swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A parked car can correctly be described as being both at rest and in motion. Reason (R): whether an object is at rest or in motion depends on the reference point chosen.

add.q: Assertion (A): A parked car can correctly be described as being both at rest (relative to the ground) and in motion (relative to a passing car). Reason (R): The kinematic equation v^2 = u^2 + 2as does not contain the time variable t, so it can be used even when the time taken is unknown. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): The equation v^2 = u^2 + 2as can be used to find the displacement of a braking car even if the exact time taken to stop is unknown. Reason (R): this kinematic equation does not contain the time (t) at all.

add.q: Assertion (A): The equation v = u + at can be used to find the displacement of a braking car even if the exact time taken to stop is unknown. Reason (R): The kinematic equation v^2 = u^2 + 2as does not contain the time (t) at all, so it can be used to find displacement without knowing the time taken. Choose the correct option.
